prompt.en: Which commander captured Detroit in July 1812 and was later killed at Queenston Heights?
prompt.fr: Quel commandant a pris Détroit en juillet 1812 avant d'être tué à Queenston Heights?

explanation.en: Major-General Sir Isaac Brock took Detroit in July 1812. He died a few months later holding Queenston Heights, near Niagara Falls, against an American assault that failed.
explanation.fr: Le major-général sir Isaac Brock a pris Détroit en juillet 1812. Il est mort quelques mois plus tard en tenant Queenston Heights, près des chutes Niagara, contre un assaut américain qui a échoué.

source.quote: Major-General Sir Isaac Brock captured Detroit but was killed while defending against an American attack at Queenston Heights, near Niagara Falls, a battle the Americans lost.
